errands.title: The Fate of Our Company
errands.posting: The merchant ship Highwind sunk some hundred thousand dohms off Warjilis Harbor. The vessel was carrying a product vital to the future of our company. It must be retrieved.

errands.title: Salvage Expedition Tour
errands.posting: Experience life on the open ocean with our salvage expedition tour! Sunken treasure may await the fortunate! Meals included, novices welcome.

errands.title: Diving Expedition Tour
errands.posting: Now accepting admissions for our diving expedition tour! Experience high adventure and amass a quick fortune in the process. It's a hero's life on the open seas, where secret treasures await! All are welcome!

errands.title: Rhana Strait
errands.posting: Long ago, the trading ship Enterprise fell victim to the violent waters of the Rhana Strait and sunk to the bottom of the sea, taking its valuable cargo with it. I have a good idea of where she sank. Anyone interested might want to try their hand at salvaging her goods.

errands.title: Dredge Work
errands.posting:
NOW HIRING DIVERS

Make your fortune fast while doing enjoyable work!

errands.title: The Hindenburg
errands.posting: A request has come in to raise a sunken ship. It seems a trade vessel called the Hindenburg went down some sixty thousand dohms into the Bay of Obell. The professional salvage guilds' services come too dear, so they're looking for someone to do it on the cheap.

errands.title: The Falcon
errands.posting: Long ago, a cargo ship called the Falcon met with a great storm and sank in the West Bugross Sea, taking the continental tributes in its cargo to the bottom of the ocean. I know the general location where she went down. If you're interested, I suggest you try to bring her up.

errands.title: Mesa's Legacy
errands.posting: A boat used by King Mesa, the hero who saved humanity during the Cataclysm, is said to be somewhere at the bottom of the bay near Goug. Legend has it that the ship is packed full of the treasures King Mesa received from the gods. It sounds too good to be true, so I took the liberty of knocking the fee down for you.

errands.title: The Durga
errands.posting: The Durga, a trade ship, has sunk some one-hundred-forty dohms into the Gulf of Carnen. The Durga was carrying a number of valuable items when it went down, and the vessel's owners need them back.

errands.title: Lionel Emissary
errands.posting: A ship secretly escorting an emissary from Lionel Castle has been set upon by pirates and sunk. It seems the vessel's cargo was very important indeed, as the castle staff are panicked beyond words. I myself smell a money-making opportunity.

errands.title: Zaland Embassy Antiques
errands.posting: A number of valuables to be donated to the Zaland Embassy were lost when the ship carrying them sunk in a storm, with antique treasures among them. If you're interested, you might try raising the vessel.

errands.title: Stolen Tomes
errands.posting: Several ancient tomes were stolen from the Gariland Akademy for the Magickal Arts, but the thief boarded a ferry which promptly sank. The passengers all escaped safely, but their belongings still rest at the bottom of the sea. This is your chance.

errands.title: Enjoyable Salvage Work
errands.posting:
DIVERS WANTED

Dissatisfied with your current income? Want good pay for easy work?

We've got just what you need! Have fun working in a cheerful environment! Beginners welcome!

errands.title: Gleddia Isle
errands.posting: Gleddia Isle lies forty thousand dohms into the Inlet of Riovanes. The waters surrounding the island are infamous, and ships oft run aground or are capsized by the swift currents. Salvaged merchant ships can yield valuable cargo.

errands.title: Foundered Vessel
errands.posting: One of our merchant ships has run aground near Gleddia Isle in the Inlet of Riovanes. Like as not, our company will go bankrupt if naught is done. Please help.

errands.title: The Dawn Queen
errands.posting: One of our trade ships, the Dawn Queen, has sunk fifty thousand dohms into the Bay of Seijista. Please raise the vessel for us. Note that the Dawn Queen was carrying something of great import for our company president.

errands.title: Abandoned Mine
errands.posting: Explore an abandoned mine and learn to fear the darkness! Buried treasure may await the brave and fortunate! What mysteries will you unearth?

errands.title: Mining Expedition
errands.posting: Have you considered becoming a coal miner? Earn coin for honest work, and mayhap discover hidden treasure! Join us, and make your dreams come true!

errands.title: Old Toppa's Will
errands.posting: There's a hidden vein of ore in the long-abandoned Coldmann Mine. Old Toppa, who used to work at the mine, said as much in his last will and testament, so I know it's true.

errands.title: Second Mining Expedition
errands.posting: Have you considered becoming a miner? Earn coin for honest work, and mayhap discover hidden treasure! Dig as much or as little as you like!

errands.title: Miner's Dream
errands.posting: Now that the cave mimic has been exterminated and digging has resumed in the Ular Mine, our company is in need of more miners. Applicants must be able to commit to working twelve to fourteen consecutive days. This is your chance to strike it rich.

errands.title: Miner Shortage
errands.posting: A cave-in has left us with a shortage of miners. Anyone willing to work for a period of approximately eight days is welcome to apply.

errands.title: Miners Wanted
errands.posting:
MINERS WANTED

The expansion of Ducatia Mine requires more miners. Small number of open positions. Apply for a short-term contract of approximately 5 days. Pay based on performance.

errands.title: Mount Gulg Mother Lode
errands.posting: There's more than lava lies sleeping in Mount Gulg! I've it on good authority the volcano hides a rich vein of gold, though few enough would dare prospect it. For even if the mountain sleeps, the perils of its monster-infested slopes abound. Have you the courage to take a chance and strike it rich?

errands.title: Endless Caverns
errands.posting: They say there's gold to be had in the Endless Caverns, a labyrinthine series of caves from which no one has ever returned. It may be no more than a rumor, but it's surely worth a look.

errands.title: Himca Cliffs
errands.posting: There's gold in the Himca Cliffs! Yes, those mysterious mist-shrouded peaks stretching up to the heavens harbor untold riches! If only someone could find those veins...

errands.title: Ore of the Gods
errands.posting: Legend has it that the Godsvale contains a deposit of ore to put any other in Ivalice to shame. Worth a look, don't you think?

errands.title: Past Glory
errands.posting: Balvack Mine, with its lucrative veins of silver, was alive with miners seeking their fortunes. Even though the mine is now abandoned, rumors of undiscovered seams of ore still abound. Could there really be something left in there?

errands.title: More Miners Wanted
errands.posting:
MINERS WANTED

The expansion of Ducatia Mine requires more miners. Small number of open positions. Apply for a short-term contract of 5 days. Pay based on performance.

errands.title: The Lorraide Mining Concern
errands.posting: The Lorraide Mining Concern went under some years past. Those in the know reckon the miners, realizing they would never be paid, simply put down their picks and abandoned the veins they were working. You might look into it if you're in need of coin.

errands.title: A Miner's Tale
errands.posting: Those were good times. Back during the gold rush, Mount Ourobos was alive with prospectors, each with a dream of striking it rich. But that's all over. I wonder what the old mountain's like now?

errands.title: Death's Gorge
errands.posting: Legend has it that in Death's Gorge there lies the hulking corpse of a demon slain in a battle with a god. Over the eons it turned to stone, and might contain untapped mineral riches. Investigate it, if you dare.

errands.title: Frontier Contest
errands.posting: Calling all adventurers! Compete for fabulous prizes in untrodden frontiers! Detailed information available upon request. Contact the Merchant Council today!

errands.title: Lake Poescas Depths
errands.posting: While fishing on Lake Poescas, I noticed something on the lake bed that appeared to be the remains of a structure. I suspect it might be a lost ruin, but anyone with a passing interest should look into the matter.

errands.title: Second Frontier Contest
errands.posting: Calling all adventurers! After the success of our first contest, we are delighted to announce a second! Detailed information available upon request. Contact the Merchant Council today!

errands.title: Ancient Wonder
errands.posting: I am an adventurer traveling Ivalice in search of the lost wonders said to be concealed in her remotest reaches. I recently uncovered ruins on the Lenalian Plateau thought to exist only in legend. I am in need of assistants to help me, as I intend to journey back to the site. Those of strong constitution preferred.

errands.title: Third Frontier Contest
errands.posting: Calling all adventurers! After the success of our last two frontier contests, we are sponsoring yet a third! Detailed information available upon request. Contact the Merchant Council today!

errands.title: The Siedge Weald
errands.posting: I was out for a stroll a few days past, when my path led me deep into the Siedge Weald. As I walked, I caught a glimpse of some dilapidated ruins through the trees. I had heard of an ancient wonder in these parts, but could I have been the one to find it? I pray that someone will go and confirm my suspicions.

errands.title: Beddha Sandwaste
errands.posting: I recently traversed the Beddha Sandwaste on a trading expedition, when I spotted something that resembled an ancient ruin. Might it be one of the legendary wonders I've heard of? Anyone interested would do well to investigate.

errands.title: Lamzen the Adventurer
errands.posting: A traveling salesman I met mentioned that he saw some ancient buildings of gigantic proportions in the Zeklaus Desert. Could they be the lost ruins of legend? Join my party and help us find them.

errands.title: Ruins at Dugeura Pass
errands.posting: I saw them—some manner of strange ruins near Dugeura Pass. There one instant, gone the next they were. Might they be an ancient wonder of note?

errands.title: Frontier Expedition
errands.posting: Find mystery and adventure on an expedition to Ivalice's frontiers! You may even discover a long-lost ancient wonder! Join us for the journey of a lifetime!

errands.title: Fenland Mystery
errands.posting: While out on a hunting trip, I spotted what appeared to be ancient ruins in the Tchigolith Fenlands. Could they be one of the ancient wonders that I've heard about? Anyone interested should investigate further.

errands.title: Cellar Dungeon
errands.posting: While excavating a new cellar for my manor, I happened upon a most foreboding maze of tunnels—no doubt a relic from an ancient time. I am looking for brave souls with knowledge of such labyrinths to join me in investigating it.

errands.title: Adventurers Wanted
errands.posting: Calling all adventurers! We will soon be departing in search of ancient wonders and are in need of assistants to help us on our expedition. We expect it to last approximately ten days.

errands.title: Eke's Testimony
errands.posting: I'd bet my eyeteeth that what I saw up on that mountain was one of those ancient wonders. Not seen aught like it in my life. 'Course, I got spooked and ran, but I saw enough. They was ruins, all right.

errands.title: Merchant's Regret
errands.posting: I have seen something resembling ruins along one of the trade routes leading to the city. At first I paid it no heed, but I later speculated that it was one of the lost ancient wonders I have heard tell of.

errands.title: Rain-swept Slopes
errands.posting: Have you heard of Mount Vector? Those sodden slopes, where precipitation falls every day of the year, are said to hide an ancient wonder. If you're interested, you may want to investigate further.

errands.title: Twilight Gutsco
errands.posting: Brigands swarm on Mount Kasco, and their leader is rumored to be none other than Twilight Gutsco, a thief with a bounty on his head, and wanted for a spate of robberies. These outlaws must be apprehended if travelers are to pass through the mountains safely.

errands.title: The Behemoth
errands.posting: A behemoth has been attacking my livestock. It seems to live up in the mountains near my farm. Please rid us of this dreadful beast.

errands.title: Wains Targeted
errands.posting: Bandits have appeared on the trade route between Dorter and Gollund—and they only seem to be targeting our company's chocobo wains. Please deal with them before we suffer any more losses.

errands.title: Young Lord Pappal
errands.client: Captain Gomez of the Lesalia Guard
errands.posting: Calling all brave adventurers! The son of a certain duke, a relation of the king of Ivalice, desires a dragon's tooth. Anyone procuring such a tooth will receive a reward from young Lord Pappal himself.

errands.title: In the Darkness
errands.posting: Monsters have infested a small cave just outside of the city. Please get rid of them before someone is hurt. Any and all help welcome.

errands.title: The Typhoon
errands.posting: I've considerable information on a wanted criminal named Bevester "Typhoon" Karzst. The brigand has been spotted in town and has a sizeable bounty on his head. Keep an eye out for him.

errands.title: Minimas the Melancholy
errands.posting: The door to my cellar has been blocked by an aggressive fiend known as a trap door. The valuables I store there may be safe from robbers, but they needn't be safe from me as well! Please help.

errands.title: Terrible Cave Mimic
errands.posting: A cave mimic has taken up residence in the entrance to the Ular Mine, trapping a number of miners inside. Please save them.

errands.title: Zerro's Challenge
errands.posting:
I recently received the following note from Zerro, a foul brigand who is terrorizing the locals.

Dearest Viscount Barfire,
I am coming to steal your riches!
Love,
Zerro, Master Thief

Please put a stop to his plans!

errands.title: Zerro Strikes
errands.posting:
I recently received the following note from Zerro, a no-good burglar whose exploits are causing mayhem.

Dearest Baron Barthundra,
I am coming to steal your riches!
Love,
Zerro, Master Thief

Please stop this man!

errands.title: Zerro's Return
errands.posting:
I recently received the following note from Zerro, a deranged thief who is becoming quite the nuisance.

Dearest Marquis Barfrost,
I am coming to steal your riches!
Love,
Zerro, Master Thief

You must stop this brazen madman!

errands.title: Zerro Strikes Again
errands.posting:
I recently received the following note from Zerro, a shameless burglar.

Dearest Count Bardeth,
I am coming to steal your riches!
Love,
Zerro, Master Thief

Please stop this brigand before tragedy befalls my collection!

errands.title: Zerro's Final Bow
errands.posting:
I recently received the following note from that dastardly crook Zerro.

My darling Lady Focara,
I am coming to steal your heart.
Love,
Zerro, Master Thief

I implore you, save my daughter from this foul blackguard!

errands.title: Extinct Beast
errands.posting: A chimera—a beast long thought to have gone extinct—has appeared in our town and the people are afeared. Please rid us of this monster.

errands.title: Metamorphosed Misery
errands.posting: Help me, please! My pet dog has turned into a monster! I fear my only option is to slay the beast, but I cannot bring myself to do it.

errands.title: Fia's Wish
errands.posting: pleas stop the branah pieruts. they are herting the peeple in my vilage. help us!!!!

errands.title: Missing Boy
errands.posting: Someone please look for my darling son. He disappeared several days ago. He was wearing a yellow hat, blue breeches, and a red doublet.

errands.title: Father's Nightmare
errands.posting: My beloved daughter Cornelia has been kidnapped! The culprit is a man who calls himself "Jacques le Rapteur." He is demanding our family jewels as ransom. Please rescue my daughter!

errands.title: Ducal Disaster
errands.client: Captain Gomez of the Lesalia Guard
errands.posting: Calling all brave adventurers! The son of a certain duke—a relation to the king of Ivalice, no less—has been abducted by a person or persons unknown, and must be rescued. Interested parties should put their names forward forthwith. You will be compensated.

errands.title: My Little Carrot
errands.posting:
Has anyone seen my Carrot?

Please find my darling pet. She has been missing for a number of days, and I am beside myself with worry. I will reward anyone who finds her. 

Name: Carrot
Breed: Malboro

errands.title: Cries in the Dark
errands.posting: Night after night, disquieting moans can be heard coming from an old dwelling on the outskirts of town. Please investigate the cause of this unsettling phenomenon.

errands.title: Shoreline Defense
errands.posting: Objects of undetermined origin have been washing up on the shore. Please investigate this matter, as the townspeople have begun to grow uneasy.

errands.title: Monster in the Well
errands.posting: Rumor has it that a monster has taken up residence in a long-abandoned well. It's making us dreadfully nervous. Please look into the matter.

errands.title: Nightwalker
errands.posting: A strange figure has been seen prowling the city streets at night. Please investigate and set our minds at ease.

errands.title: Monster Mansion
errands.posting: An old house, long thought abandoned, now shows signs of human—or inhuman—presence. Please investigate, as it is causing a stir amongst the townspeople.

errands.title: Historic Revolt
errands.posting: Lately I've been seeing a large number of youngsters digging for something in the mountains outside of town. I wish I knew what they were up to. Could someone look into it?

errands.title: Secret Society Secrets
errands.posting: I have determined that a spy has infiltrated our organization. I have three suspects. Follow them and see who the traitor is.

errands.title: Crucial Appraisal
errands.posting: It has recently come to my attention that one of my house's heirlooms may in fact be a forgery. It has been passed down through my family for generations, so this naturally comes as quite a shock. Please determine whether it is genuine.

errands.title: Lettre d'Amour
errands.posting: I implore you to deliver this letter to my beloved in Warjilis. The letter is highly confidential, so it must be handed to her directly. I shall repay your kindness with a most valuable treasure.

errands.title: Minimas the Mournful
errands.posting: I can no longer open my family vault. My riches are safe from robbers, but they needn't be safe from me as well! Please help.

errands.title: Unknown Vegetation
errands.posting: I've received a report that someone has discovered a strange new type of plant in the Germinas Woods. I would dearly love to obtain a sample, but alas, the woods are home to all manner of monsters. Please go and find a sample of this plant in my stead.

errands.title: Love Is in the Air
errands.posting: Please take this letter to my beloved who lives in Riovanes. The letter is of great import, and must be delivered directly to him. I offer a fair reward, and promise to give a little something extra for a job well done.

errands.title: Cattedona
errands.posting: I am terribly shy. So much so that I have never even had a real conversation with anyone. Please help me learn how to speak with other people.

errands.title: Arithmeticks Tutor Wanted
errands.posting: I am a studint at the magick skool. But, I dont understand maths. Very good. Pleeze teech me maths. Thank you.

errands.title: Minstrel in Distress
errands.posting: You will oft find a fellow nursing a drink in the corner of the tavern: Mameco the minstrel. It seems he is in something of a creative rut. Please help him, if you can.

errands.title: Minimas the Miserable
errands.posting: I can no longer open the door to my lavish mansion. My house may be safe from robbers, but it needn't be safe from me as well! Please help.

errands.title: Clockwork Faire
errands.posting: Assistants wanted! Help us prepare for the annual Goug Clockwork Faire! Experience with machines preferred.

errands.title: Mameco the Minstrel
errands.posting: The Eagrose Tavern will soon play host to Mameco the minstrel's long-awaited return to the stage. We are currently recruiting dancers for the upcoming performance.

errands.title: Gysahl Greens
errands.posting:
HELP WANTED

Our entire establishment has been reserved for a party. We require extra hands to perform odd jobs, prepare for the celebrations, and assist on the day. The work is none too strenuous.

errands.title: The Wandering Gambler
errands.posting: The Blackjack, a famous casino ship beloved of many a noble, has docked at port. According to my sources, one of the games on the far starboard side has been quite generous as of late. It might be worth a try!

errands.title: The Wandering Gambler Returns
errands.posting: The Blackjack, a famous casino ship beloved of many a noble, has docked at port. According to my sources, one of the games on the far port side has been quite generous as of late. It might be worth a try!

errands.title: Guard Duty
errands.posting: This is an appeal for protection to accompany our chocobo wains along the route from Eagrose to Dorter. In these truly troubled times, monsters have appeared on the trade roads and are beginning to threaten our caravans. Please protect the wains and the cargo they carry.

errands.title: Food for Thought
errands.posting: Please deliver my son's favorite food to him on the outskirts of Dorter. He always has chocobo paprikash on his birthday, but these old bones of mine are too weak to take it to him personally.

errands.title: Short-term Tutor
errands.posting: Wanted: Private magick tutor for the ten days until my son's examination. Pay based on son's score.

errands.title: The Yardrow Melee
errands.posting:
The Month of Cancer Has Arrived!

Now accepting applications for the annual Yardrow Melee. Combatants of all backgrounds welcome.

errands.title: The Zaland Melee
errands.posting:
The Month of Aries Is Here!

Seeking an opponent worthy of your skills? Enter the Zaland Melee! Now accepting applications!

errands.title: The Gariland Magick Melee
errands.posting:
The Month of Virgo Is Upon Us!

Confident in your command of the magickal arts? Then put your money where your magick is and enter the Gariland Magick Melee!

errands.title: Goug Artificers' Contest
errands.posting:
A Contest for the Month of Sagittarius!

Good with your hands? Able to fix anything? Then prove it at the annual Goug Artificers' Contest! Become the hero of all Goug!

collection.name: Chaos Shrine
collection.description: When the world was young, the primal deities sealed Jaed the Netherlord deep beneath the earth. Its decrepit chambers tainted by a foul and unholy air, the Chaos Shrine is said to mark the site of his prison.

collection.name: Eureka
collection.description: This once prosperous capital of the Kashka Dynasty was destroyed in the Cataclysm, along with the vast legacy of its royal family. It is now a necrohol, populated by spirits drawn to the shades of past glory.

collection.name: Pandaemonium
collection.description: The capital of the ancient Palamecian Empire. With peaks exceeding nine thousand dohms, the towering mountain range encircling the city guarded it from even the most ambitious airship captains. A warping device was the only means of bypassing this natural barrier.

collection.name: Mirage Tower
collection.description: This ancient tower links the Castle of Ronka to the earth below. Its magicked facade shields it against casual inspection; however, the sheer size of the outer wall renders the enchantment unstable, causing the tower to shimmer mirage-like at times.

collection.name: Flying Fortress
collection.description: The winged ones of ages past possessed technology allowing them to transmute cloudstone into crystals, like the ones that keep this castle aloft. Unfortunately, both the winged ones and their wondrous knowledge were lost in the Cataclysm.

collection.name: Matoya's Cave
collection.description: Court thaumaturge Matoya once enjoyed the adoration of the ancient Ronkan peoples, but that ended with her creation of monsters known as the Enthralled—a work of witchcraft to the lay eye. It was then she took up residence here.

collection.name: Crystal Tower
collection.description: This spire, once the heart of the ancient kingdom of Baron, was fortified by the labyrinthine city at its base. The tower's crystal walls were a symbol of the royal family's wealth and power, but also of oppression.

collection.name: Floating Continent
collection.description: Theories once abounded as to what this airborne mass of land might be. Academics have now settled on one prevailing hypothesis: the Cataclysm caused a shift in the balance of subterranean cloudstone, allowing it to surface.

collection.name: Citadel of Trials
collection.description: Once a school of training for the royal guard in the ancient kingdom of Baron. Graduates of the institution filled the ranks of the Red Wings, a prestigious airship corps, but the castle and its esteemed soldiers were lost in the Cataclysm.

collection.name: Tower of Babil
collection.description: A legendary tower that extends to the heavens from deep below the earth. Also called the Tower of the Colossi, this mighty spire withstood the Cataclysm, and is an invaluable remnant of ancient civilization.

collection.name: Ronkan Ruins
collection.description: The Ronkan Dynasty dominated the world from its skyborne castle until an enigmatic plague brought about its sudden and tragic demise. Today its empty ruins float in a cold and desolate silence.

collection.name: Falgabard
collection.description: This village is said to have been inhabited by an order of dark knights. While the fell blades of these knights lent them great power, they also cut short their lives. The order's numbers dwindled, until at last none remained.

collection.name: Phantom Train
collection.description: The Phantom Train became so known for its primary purpose during an ancient age of war—the transport of battalions of the ghastly Enthralled, a race of artificial monsters. It is also called the Chariot of the Damned.

collection.name: Tozus Village
collection.description: A race of gnomes known as the Lilliputians inhabits this village. These gnomes were ruled by a merciless dictator until a mighty giant known as Atlas freed them at long last from their oppression. The name Tozus derives from an ancient word meaning "very distant place."

collection.name: Chocobo Forest
collection.description: Naught but a glimpse of light creeps into this deep wood. Rare breeds of chocobo thrive in this mystical forest, and the World Tree is rumored to be at its center. The pungent scent of chocobo fills the air.

collection.name: Semitt Falls
collection.description: A site of significance for the ancient Palamecian Empire. Mythril was mined beneath these majestic falls, while extacium—a fuel used by the airships of the day—could be gleaned from their magickal waters.

collection.name: Four-Deity Plate
collection.description: A set of four small brooches, each crafted in the image of one of the Eastern deities of the cardinal directions. The intricate inlay of fine jewels suggests the collection once belonged to nobility.

collection.name: Statuette of Lilith
collection.description: This stone idol depicts Lilith, a goddess heralded as both the first fiend and the mother of all life. Warriors through the ages have sought this figurine, believing it to grant strength.

collection.name: Scarab Charm
collection.description: An iridescent charm crafted in the shape of a beetle. It is favored among the common people as a bringer of good fortune.

collection.name: Tobacco Pipe
collection.description: This ornate pipe, once belonging to an infamous thief from the East, is primarily used for smoking tobacco. Crafted of goldentite, a hard mineral, it can also serve as a reliable weapon in desperate times.

collection.name: Coin Blade
collection.description: Once used as a divination tool by a caravan of nomadic merchants. Coins engraved with foreign markings have been strung together in the shape of a sword, hence the given name.

collection.name: Black Cat
collection.description: This figurine of a black cat has eyes of lapis lazuli and claws inlaid with diamonds. A piece of considerable antiquity, it is highly sought after among collectors.

collection.name: Hanya Mask
collection.description: A mask fashioned in the visage of a race of giant demons that ruled over a foreign land in ages past. These vicious creatures were described as the manifestation of human hatred.

collection.name: Parade Helm
collection.description: Designed for victory parades, this ceremonial helm favors flair over function. The myriad precious stones adorning the helm attest to the affluence of a once great nation.

collection.name: Moppet Bread
collection.description: A treat beloved by children since ancient times, the secret to making these bite-sized loaves of bread has been all but forgotten. This scroll contains the last known copy of the recipe.

collection.name: Goliath Bread
collection.description: Though no longer made in the modern age, these hefty loaves of leavened bread were once eaten for the energy they impart. An acquired taste enjoyed mainly by adults, this scroll contains the last known copy of the recipe.

collection.name: Calcabrina
collection.description: First popular in regions where other forms of amusement were few, these dressable dolls are now many a young girl's treasure. It is said their lifeless eyes harbor the souls of lost owners.

collection.name: Lugae
collection.description: The eccentric design of this well-loved marionette holds a nearly supernatural fascination for children. With the craft now lost to the ages, those remaining are all the more precious.

collection.name: Red Materia
collection.description: These stones, developed by the ancient Saronians, are the result of experiments in storing knowledge within gems for later generations. They are said to enhance the abilities of the possessor. Red materia is believed to contain the power to summon espers.

collection.name: Blue Materia
collection.description: These stones, developed by the ancient Saronians, are the result of experiments in storing knowledge within gems for later generations. They are said to enhance the abilities of the possessor. Blue materia is believed to augment supportive traits.

collection.name: Black Materia
collection.description: These stones, developed by the ancient Saronians, are the result of experiments in storing knowledge within gems for later generations. They are said to enhance the abilities of the possessor. Black materia is believed to harbor destructive power.

collection.name: White Materia
collection.description: These stones, developed by the ancient Saronians, are the result of experiments in storing knowledge within gems for later generations. They are said to enhance the abilities of the possessor. White materia is believed to grant the power of rebirth.

collection.name: Rat Tail
collection.description: Long used by sorcerers as a magickal reagent, this exquisite delicacy was once the catalyst for a full-scale war. It has an extremely potent flavor.

collection.name: Enchanted Pistol
collection.description: This ancient firearm used bullets infused with various magicks. In later years, bullets imbued with power directly extracted from espers came to be invented.

collection.name: Enchanted Machine Gun
collection.description: Guns of this larger type are said to have been fitted to airships in days of yore. Their bullets could be used for different purposes, depending on the magick with which they were infused.

collection.name: Zanmato
collection.description: The indecipherable script engraved into this enchanted blade identifies it as the weapon once used to slay a demon in a single blow. Its great curved blade strikes fear into the heart of any foe.

collection.name: Orb of Minwu
collection.description: The soul of Minwu, the First Mage, is said to be sealed within this stone. As such, it is sometimes called the Soul of Minwu. An orb only in name, it is in actuality comma shaped.

collection.name: Tarot de Bennstat
collection.description: Tarot cards hand-painted by Bennstat, a well-known artist. It is the only deck of its kind, and was stolen from Lesalia's National Museum of Art some years ago.

collection.name: Excalipoor
collection.description: Forged in honor of the legendary sword Excalibur. Although only a replica, this sword is extremely sharp, and has served a goodly number of adventurers.

collection.name: Yggdrasil Mistletoe
collection.description: A parasitic shrub that feeds on the bark of the World Tree. Upon sprouting, it shrivels and dies in half a day. Its leaves, if properly harvested, can be used to brew an elixir of eternal youth.

collection.name: Lance of Longibunne
collection.description: Many adventurers have lost their lives pursuing this spear, said to be capable of piercing solid stone. Legend holds it once slew a demon that had seized control of the mortal realm.

collection.name: Chocobo Cannon
collection.description: This weapon shoots fattened chocobos, which are gorged on gunpowder before being stuffed into its barrel. Highly imprecise, it never proceeded beyond the experimental stage.

collection.name: Saint Elmo's Fire
collection.description: These azure flames are said to cause spontaneous combustion in humans. As the phenomenon affects only those suffering from malady, Saint Elmo's Fire is feared as the source of both.
